title: Daily dynamic assessment and modelling of intersession processes in ambulatory psychotherapy: A proof of concept study
limitations: - Small sample size; - Lack of diversity in sample (mostly female participants); - Psychometric concerns about single-item scales for treatment-related emotions; - Potential for measurement effects on ISP frequency and intensity.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly stated in the paper, but the authors may have made them available through supplementary materials or repositories. The study used the DynAMo software package for data collection.
